bom.text: And it must needs be that the power of God must be with him, even unto his commanding you that ye must obey. But behold, it was not he, but it was the Spirit of the Lord which was in him, which opened his mouth to utterance that he could not shut it.

quote.text: We know that the Lord will comfort all of those who try to follow Him. And He offers us the great blessing and trust to help Him keep His promise to succor Heavenly Father’s children in their tests along their mortal journey toward home.
quote.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring

cfm.text: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
cfm.week: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths”: Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12

bom.text: And again I say unto you, ye must repent, and be baptized in my name, and become as a little child, or ye can in nowise inherit the kingdom of God.

quote.text: To those at or nearing their “mile 90,” ferrying the unimaginable, or if you feel like I did, both depleted and defeated, I promise that as you expend even your last drops of energy to ask, His helping hand will ultimately give you that much-needed leg up. And even when the outcome or the timing is not what you plead for, take solace knowing that feeling broken does not mean you’ve been abandoned by God.
quote.speaker: Elder Michael A. Dunn

cfm.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.
cfm.week: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths”: Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12

bom.text: But ye will teach them to walk in the ways of truth and soberness; ye will teach them to love one another, and to serve one another.

quote.text: On this path to more unity, let us not miss the unifying power of the sacrament. Each week we gather as fellow disciples of Jesus Christ to renew our baptismal covenant and to remember all the covenants we’ve personally made with God. My dear brothers and sisters, the sacrament can become a fresh starting point for our personal relationship with God and for a greater Christ-centered unity in our lives.
quote.speaker: President Dieter F. Uchtdorf

cfm.text: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
cfm.week: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths”: Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12

bom.text: Little children cannot repent; wherefore, it is awful wickedness to deny the pure mercies of God unto them, for they are all alive in him because of his mercy.

quote.text: The Atonement of Jesus Christ is the fulfillment of the greatest promise God made—that Jesus Christ would be our Savior and Redeemer. The power and reach of that covenant is infinite and eternal.
quote.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quote.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants

cfm.text: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
cfm.week: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths”: Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12

bom.text: For behold, the Spirit of the Lord ceaseth soon to strive with them; for behold, they have rejected the prophets, and Jeremiah have they cast into prison. And they have sought to take away the life of my father, insomuch that they have driven him out of the land.

quote.text: The Savior taught this loving principle of discipleship from the very beginning of His mortal ministry. In the Gospel of John, He ministers to a Samaritan woman. We do not know her name. We have come to know her as “the woman at the well.” Her interaction with the Lord Jesus Christ teaches many lessons. One critical lesson is the example of the Savior being quick to offer grace and transformative help.
quote.speaker: Elder Paul H. Sinclair
quote.talk: Quick to Help, Slow to Judge

cfm.text: ¶ Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
cfm.week: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths”: Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12

bom.text: And now, because thou hast done this with such unwearyingness, behold, I will bless thee forever; and I will make thee mighty in word and in deed, in faith and in works; yea, even that all things shall be done unto thee according to thy word, for thou shalt not ask that which is contrary to my will.

quote.text: It is our faith in Jesus Christ that gives us the courage to accept a calling from our priesthood leaders even when we feel inadequate or without sufficient time to accept the responsibility.
quote.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quote.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ

cfm.text: Wherefore, ye must press forward with a steadfastness in Christ, having a perfect brightness of hope, and a love of God and of all men. Wherefore, if ye shall press forward, feasting upon the word of Christ, and endure to the end, behold, thus saith the Father: Ye shall have eternal life.
cfm.week: “He Shall Direct Thy Paths”: Proverbs 1–4; 15–16; 22; 31; Ecclesiastes 1–3; 11–12

bom.text: Gather together whatsoever force ye can upon your march hither, and we will go speedily against those dissenters, in the strength of our God according to the faith which is in us.

quote.text: Partake of the sacrament with a humble heart, grateful for the promise that as you keep your covenants, the Holy Ghost will be your constant companion. Begin each day by asking the Father for that companionship.
quote.speaker: Sister Andrea Muñoz Spannaus

cfm.text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: Wherefore, if ye shall keep the commandments of the Lord, the Lord hath consecrated this land for the security of thy seed with the seed of my son.

quote.text: By His Atonement from the Garden of Gethsemane to the cross on Golgotha, He paid for the sins and bore the disappointments that wrack their souls and yours.
quote.speaker: Elder Ronald A. Rasband

cfm.text: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of God.

quote.text: In our day, the application of this principle is essential if we are to be true lifelong disciples of Christ. We need to live our lives with integrity and follow His example. The Lord, speaking of one servant in Nauvoo, declared, “He may be trusted because of the integrity of his heart.” Preach My Gospel teaches, “Integrity includes being honest with God, yourself, your leaders, and others.”
quote.speaker: Elder Quentin L. Cook
quote.talk: Integrity and Virtue Lead to Happiness

cfm.text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: Therefore I would that ye should be perfect even as I, or your Father who is in heaven is perfect.

quote.text: At the heart of our faith is the glorious truth that we have an adoring Father in Heaven, whose Son, our Saviour, loves to lift!
quote.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon

cfm.text: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: And it came to pass that none received authority to preach or to teach except it were by him from God. Therefore he consecrated all their priests and all their teachers; and none were consecrated except they were just men.

quote.text: Have you ever asked yourselves whether the Lord has caused your personal possessions to last longer because you have faithfully lived the law of tithing?
quote.speaker: Elder Moisés Villanueva

cfm.text: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: And he that saith that little children need baptism denieth the mercies of Christ, and setteth at naught the atonement of him and the power of his redemption.

quote.text: The Lord invites all of us to teach His gospel. Wherever we teach—in classrooms, in the mission field, in our homes, or one by one—His promise remains the same: He will help us do His work.
quote.speaker: Brother Gabriel W. Reid
quote.talk: You Are Good Enough to Teach

cfm.text: ¶ Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: And the Spirit said unto me again: Behold the Lord hath delivered him into thy hands. Yea, and I also knew that he had sought to take away mine own life; yea, and he would not hearken unto the commandments of the Lord; and he also had taken away our property.

quote.text: As we honor our covenants, the Holy Spirit of Promise seals our relationships with “efficacy, virtue, [and] force.” They are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
quote.speaker: Elder Gerrit W. Gong
quote.talk: Come to the Lord in His Holy House

cfm.text: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
cfm.week: “God Is My Salvation”: Isaiah 1–12

bom.text: For behold, thus saith the Lord: I will not show unto the wicked of my strength, to one more than the other, save it be unto those who repent of their sins, and hearken unto my words. Now therefore, I would that ye should behold, my brethren, that it shall be better for the Lamanites than for you except ye shall repent.

quote.text: Just as the man in my passport story needed an authorized stamp in his passport to enter a foreign country, so each of us needs the verifying witness of the Holy Spirit of Promise in order for us to receive the eternal blessings associated with the covenants and ordinances of the Savior’s gospel.
quote.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quote.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise

cfm.text: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: But behold, my son, this is not all; for ye ought to know as I do know, that inasmuch as ye shall keep the commandments of God ye shall prosper in the land; and ye ought to know also, that inasmuch as ye will not keep the commandments of God ye shall be cut off from his presence. Now this is according to his word.

quote.text: Along the way we should work to draw closer to Jesus Christ by increasing our humility. President Spencer W. Kimball defined humility as “teachableness.” He explained: “Teachableness [is] an ability to realize that all virtues and abilities are not concentrated in one’s self. … [Humility] is forgiving others in the realization that there may be errors of the same kind or worse [that we ourselves commit].”
quote.speaker: President Dallin H. Oaks
quote.talk: The Gospel of Jesus Christ Is for All

cfm.text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: And my soul delighteth in proving unto my people that save Christ should come all men must perish.

quote.text: Resisting the impulse to initially respond built common ground, which allowed me later to teach from a place of love. As with the Savior, “we love him, because he [loved us first].”
quote.speaker: Elder Clark G. Gilbert

cfm.text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: Ask, and it shall be given unto you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

quote.text: Therefore, let us fill our hearts with the true doctrine of Christ, which has the power to change our language and help us speak more as peacemakers today, tomorrow, and always. As we follow Jesus Christ, we will not only feel His peace, but, as Elder Ulisses Soares said, “We can become instruments of His peace in the world.”
quote.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu

cfm.text: ¶ And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: And the priests were not to depend upon the people for their support; but for their labor they were to receive the grace of God, that they might wax strong in the Spirit, having the knowledge of God, that they might teach with power and authority from God.

quote.text: As Kenzie binds herself to Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ in prayer, obedience, and covenant keeping, They help her endure what she cannot bear alone. That same enabling grace is available to all who turn to Jesus Christ.
quote.speaker: Elder Kevin J. Hathaway
quote.talk: Jesus Christ Is the Great Deliverer!

cfm.text: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: Behold, I would exhort you that when ye shall read these things, if it be wisdom in God that ye should read them, that ye would remember how merciful the Lord hath been unto the children of men, from the creation of Adam even down until the time that ye shall receive these things, and ponder it in your hearts.

quote.text: With an earned conviction, I witness that this—all of this—is the true and only way we can grow and progress and become like our heavenly parents and Savior.
quote.speaker: Sister Tamara W. Runia

cfm.text: ¶ Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments—then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea.

quote.text: Brothers and sisters, let us pray every day for eyes to see the divine appointments God places before us! Let us put compassion into action and minister to the person in front of us. It’s what Jesus did.
quote.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes

cfm.text: ¶ And therefore will the Lord wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the Lord is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
cfm.week: “A Marvellous Work and a Wonder”: Isaiah 13–14; 22; 24–30; 35

bom.text: Behold now, I do not say that these things shall be, of myself, because it is not of myself that I know these things; but behold, I know that these things are true because the Lord God has made them known unto me, therefore I testify that they shall be.

quote.text: We show our faith in Christ by making and keeping covenants with God. “A covenant is a sacred promise between God and His children. God gives the conditions for the covenant, and His children agree to obey those conditions. God promises to bless His children as they fulfill the covenant.”
quote.speaker: Elder Ciro Schmeil
quote.talk: Consider Your Ways, and from This Day Will the Lord Bless You

cfm.text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
cfm.week: “Comfort Ye My People”: Isaiah 40–49

bom.text: For behold, this life is the time for men to prepare to meet God; yea, behold the day of this life is the day for men to perform their labors.

quote.text: Many of you have recognized a discouraged missionary as an invitation to lift a servant of Jesus Christ. Wherever they serve, missionaries are being stretched and they are praying for strength. Whatever they are assigned to do, they are in need of encouragement.
quote.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring

cfm.text: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
cfm.week: “Comfort Ye My People”: Isaiah 40–49

bom.text: O, my beloved brethren, remember the awfulness in transgressing against that Holy God, and also the awfulness of yielding to the enticings of that cunning one. Remember, to be carnally-minded is death, and to be spiritually-minded is life eternal.

quote.text: Each of us can bear such a witness, for it is the Spirit—not words—that testifies of the truth. As the Lord promised, when one speaks by the power of the Holy Ghost, “the Holy Ghost shall be shed forth in bearing record unto all things whatsoever ye shall say.”
quote.speaker: Elder Gérald Caussé

cfm.text: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.
cfm.week: “Comfort Ye My People”: Isaiah 40–49
